items.label: U.S. House
items.text: U.S. Representative for California's 20th District; won the May 21, 2024 special election to succeed Kevin McCarthy and was sworn in June 3, 2024. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vince_Fong [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Vince_Fong [search summary, secondary])

items.label: California State Assembly
items.text: Member of the California State Assembly, December 5, 2016 to May 24, 2024. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vince_Fong [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Congressional staff
items.text: Staff member for Rep. Bill Thomas, working on international trade policy; district director for Rep. Kevin McCarthy for about a decade. (sources: Vince Fong campaign https://vincefong.com/about/ [search summary, primary]; Roll Call https://rollcall.com/2025/01/29/from-staffer-to-member-vince-fong-road-to-congress/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Bachelor's degree, UCLA; master's degree (Vote Smart: M.P.A., 2001 to 2003), Princeton University. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vince_Fong [search summary, secondary]; Vote Smart https://votesmart.org/candidate/biography/169357 [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Career
items.text: BallotReady lists cardiac testing at Ridgecrest Regional Hospital (2017 to 2021) and work as a registered respiratory therapist at Northwestern Memorial Hospital (2011 to 2014). (sources: BallotReady https://www.ballotready.org/people/sandra-van-scotter [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Occupation
items.text: Described in local coverage as an advocate for disability rights and veterans' issues; resident of Ridgecrest. (sources: Tehachapi News https://www.tehachapinews.com/lifestyle/tmdc-endorses-van-scotter-for-20th-congressional-district/article_a90a48e7-1fe0-454b-9019-72a3c8efb5ef.html [search summary, secondary]; The Loop (Tehachapi) https://www.theloopnewspaper.com/story/2026/04/11/local-news/sandra-van-scotter-offers-campaign-update/14745.html [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Party registration history
items.text: In a KGET questionnaire she lists registration as Democrat since 2025, No Party Preference in California 2014 to 2025, and Democrat in Illinois 2008 to 2014. (sources: KGET https://www.kget.com/news/politics/your-local-elections/2026-candidate-questionnaire-california-congressional-district-20/amp/ [search summary, secondary])
